executive_verdict.primary_failure_mode: Different inference routes do not share one autonomous policy and spending boundary
executive_verdict.most_urgent_fix: Migrate remaining plaintext bootstrap secrets and design scoped autonomous routing

findings.title: OpenAI request account race
findings.mechanism: Token acquisition followed active account after route validation
findings.recommended_fix: Implemented expected-account binding and catalog save recheck

findings.title: Cloud Ollama behind local transport
findings.mechanism: Loopback route could invoke a cloud tag
findings.root_cause: Transport locality treated as inference locality
findings.recommended_fix: Known cloud tags blocked; isolate actual local runtime egress

findings.title: Unscoped general model gateway
findings.mechanism: General API key routing bypasses Hybrid job budgets
findings.recommended_fix: Implemented revocable single-route scopes, pinned endpoint/credential, persisted call and reservation caps, bounded text-only requests, and legacy-key rejection.

findings.title: Plaintext bootstrap secrets
findings.mechanism: Paperclip login reads ordinary JSON; recoverable connector keys remain on disk
findings.recommended_fix: Implemented verified protected-storage migration; preserved existing credentials and bindings without rotation.

findings.title: Unbounded OAuth JSON
findings.mechanism: Provider bodies were buffered without byte caps
findings.recommended_fix: Implemented bounded OAuth/catalog parsing; broaden to general inference

findings.title: Google grant change during model selection
findings.mechanism: Stale catalog could be saved into a changed grant

findings.title: Credential subprocess could stall
findings.mechanism: Hung DPAPI process blocks persistence queue

findings.title: Incomplete Google response could pass
findings.mechanism: Nonempty partial text treated as connection success

ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Existing secrets are outside encrypted store

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Scope autonomous model routes and spending
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: General gateway differs from reviewed jobs
Model tags alone cannot prove offline execution

ordered_fix_plan.goal: Complete live provider conformance and recovery tests
ordered_fix_plan.why_now: Fixture success is not operational readiness

remaining_limits: Single trusted local operator and one server process
Reservations are not provider invoice guarantees
Local-only egress isolation and live provider conformance remain separate work
